title: Toast Notifications :D
description: Latest updates will now show through this notification! Cheers in keeping you updated on the changes made in this site ^^

title: Latin Honors Calculator Sunset
description: The Latin Honors calculator has been removed and consolidated into the main Grades (changed from Honors) Calculator. All Latin honors calculations are now available on the Grades Calculator page.

title: Lite Mode
description: You will now be able to quickly compute your general averages per term instead of encoding every subject. This can be found in the Grades Calculator Page.

title: Updating the Calculation of the Latin Honors
description: The Latin Honors calculation now follows one stated by the institution, based from the APC Student Handbook.

title: Grade Converter System Update
description: The Grade Converter now supports the official APC and UP grading systems with accurate conversions. Convert between APC (US-based 4.0 scale), UP (Philippine-based 5.0 scale), and percentage grades. Features expanded grading tables with letter grades for both systems.

title: SHS Calculator Integration
description: The SHS Calculator page is now fully functional with the same features and layout as the Grades Calculator. You can now compute your SHS grades and honors eligibility on a dedicated page.

title: Updated User Interface
description: Updated the user interface of the Grades Calculator and Latin Honors Calculator pages to have a cleaner, more modern look. The layout is now more organized and easier to navigate, with better spacing and typography.
